d: A Godot 4 procedural voxel terrain engine that began as an editor-oriented sampled point-field visualizer and evolved into a modular offline generation and runtime streaming architecture. PointFieldResource is the authoritative regular-lattice scalar-field representation; visualization and meshers are consumers. Surface Nets is implemented as an algorithm consumer, ArrayMesh output exists, chunk assets and manifests provide the persisted terrain boundary, and ChunkStreamer handles runtime loading and target-relative residency of precomputed terrain. The project also has deterministic headless validation, dedicated validation scenes, GitHub Pages Integration Preview browser/mobile QA, shared mobile controls, version/release workflows, ADRs, performance evidence conventions, and a mutable ROADMAP.md. The long-term target is large precomputed terrain such as a several-kilometer asteroid, with generation and meshing remaining offline while runtime becomes primarily an asset-loading, residency, and eventual LOD problem. A dedicated Project Engineering Steward now maintains this mutable handoff JSON as an engineering-memory and continuity layer over authoritative repository, ADR, roadmap, test, and validation sources.
